## Page 11

▪The Arbitral Tribunal ruled in favor of Thai Re and dismissed all claims brought forward.
▪Litigant was ordered to pay Thai Re the outstanding balance in full (THB 140 million) plus accrued 
default interest 5% p.a., to reimburse Thai Re’s arbitration costs in full and some part of legal and 
other costs, in total (a) THB 209.4 million and (b) SGD 485.5 thousand [or equivalent to the total of 
THB 221.5 million].
▪Litigant sent email on 3 February 2026 declared its intention to comply with the arbitral award and to 
make full payment before 27 February 2026.
▪The additional amount between the total received of THB 221.5 million and the outstanding balance 
of THB 140 million, or THB 81 million will be booked in P&L in Q1/2026.The Arbitral Tribunal issued its final award on 27 January 2026Operation updated
